description: Brand CRUD (แบรนด์/ยี่ห้อ): create a dedicated brandStore, a back-office web brand management screen, and make the product add/edit brand pickers read from the store so new brands appear. productStore holds only products (no brands today), so a dedicated store is correct. Brand type exists in src/types/product.ts; MOCK_BRANDS in src/data/mockProducts.ts. Independent of the other FEATs.
steps: Create src/store/brandStore.ts following src/store/branchStore.ts house style: zustand create + persist, name 'pos-brands', storage: createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage), seeded state.brands from MOCK_BRANDS (import from ../data/mockProducts). Export: getBrands(): Brand[], getBrand(id): Brand | undefined, addBrand(data: Omit<Brand,'id'|'productCount'> & { productCount?: number }): Brand (id = `brand-${Date.now()}-${random}`, default status 'active', productCount 0), updateBrand(id, updates): void, deleteBrand(id): void, each calling logAction('แบรนด์', ...). Also export getBrandProductCount(brandId: string): number that counts useProductStore.getState().products where p.brandId === brandId (import useProductStore from ./productStore) so productCount is derived live. Import Brand from ../types/product.

Create src/screens/web/WebBrandScreen.tsx modeled on WebBranchManageScreen.tsx (WebColors, card grid, inline add/edit form, window.confirm delete, empty state). Fields: name (required, 'ชื่อแบรนด์') and a status toggle (ใช้งาน/ปิดใช้). Show live product count per brand via brandStore.getBrandProductCount(id) ('N สินค้า'). Thai loading/error/empty ('ยังไม่มีแบรนด์'). Use a refreshKey pattern like WebBranchManageScreen.

Register in src/navigation/WebNavigator.tsx: import, add case 'brands': return <WebBrandScreen />;, add brands: 'แบรนด์' to PAGE_NAMES, and extend the access-key reuse list so 'brands' maps to the 'products' permission key (same mechanism as FEAT-001's 'suppliers').
Add src/components/web/WebSidebar.tsx NAV_ITEMS entry: { route: 'brands', icon: 'ribbon-outline', label: 'แบรนด์' }.

Make the mobile brand picker store-backed in src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx: replace MOCK_BRANDS in the brand PickerModal items with brandStore.getBrands().filter(b => b.status === 'active'); keep the '— ไม่ระบุ —' option, the onSelect wiring (setBrandId/setBrandName), and product save (brandId/brandName) unchanged.

Make the web product modal brand dropdown store-backed in src/screens/web/WebProductScreen.tsx: replace the MOCK_BRANDS reads in the product-form brand dropdown (the selected-name lookup and the active-brand list) with brandStore.getBrands(). Additionally, rewire the 'มาสเตอร์ › ยี่ห้อ' tab (local `brands` useState seeded from MOCK_BRANDS plus handleAddBrand/handleSaveEditBrand/handleDeleteBrand/handleToggleBrandStatus) to read from and mutate brandStore (add/update/delete/toggle), so brand edits persist and immediately reflect in both pickers. Keep product save working. The store is the single source of truth for brands.
acceptance_criteria: src/store/brandStore.ts exists, persists under 'pos-brands', seeds from MOCK_BRANDS, exposes get/add/update/delete + getById + getBrandProductCount, and logs actions.
WebBrandScreen is reachable from the sidebar (แบรนด์), supports CRUD with Thai labels, confirm-on-delete, empty state, and shows a live product count; added brands persist across reload.
A brand created in WebBrandScreen appears in BOTH the mobile AddEditProductScreen brand picker and the WebProductScreen product-modal brand dropdown, and a product can be saved with it.
`npm run lint` shows no new tsc errors; `npm test` shows no new failures.
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm no new tsc errors in brandStore.ts / WebBrandScreen.tsx / AddEditProductScreen.tsx / WebProductScreen.tsx.
Run `npm test` and confirm no new failing suites.
Manual: add brand 'ทดสอบแบรนด์' in WebBrandScreen, reload (persists), then open both product forms and confirm it is selectable; the brand master tab count updates after assigning it to a product.
findings: DONE. brandStore (src/store/brandStore.ts) persists under 'pos-brands' (createJSONStorage(() => persistStorage)), seeds from MOCK_BRANDS, function-API house style like branchStore/supplierStore. Exports: getBrands, getBrand, getBrandProductCount(brandId) [counts live from useProductStore.getState().products where p.brandId===brandId], addBrand(data: Omit<Brand,'id'|'productCount'> & {productCount?}) [id=`brand-${Date.now()}-${random36(4)}`, default status 'active', productCount 0], updateBrand, deleteBrand — each mutation calls logAction('แบรนด์', 'เพิ่ม'|'แก้ไข'|'ลบ', ...). WebBrandScreen.tsx modeled on WebSupplierScreen/WebBranchManageScreen (WebColors, card grid, inline add/edit form with name + status Switch (ใช้งาน/ปิดใช้), window.confirm delete, empty state 'ยังไม่มีแบรนด์', window.alert guard on empty name). Card shows live product count ('N สินค้า') via getBrandProductCount + status label. refreshKey pattern for re-render after mutation. REGISTERED in WebNavigator: import WebBrandScreen; PAGE_NAMES['brands']='แบรนด์'; switch case 'brands' -> <WebBrandScreen/>; access key REUSES 'products' — wired in navigate() accessKey list ['suppliers','brands']->'products', routeAccessKey list, and WebSidebar visibleItems accessKey list (mirrors FEAT-001 suppliers pattern). WebSidebar NAV_ITEMS entry after 'suppliers': { route:'brands', icon:'ribbon-outline', label:'แบรนด์' }. PICKERS now store-backed (single source of truth = brandStore): (1) mobile AddEditProductScreen.tsx brand PickerModal items = [{id:'',name:'— ไม่ระบุ —'}, ...brandStore.getBrands().filter(b=>b.status==='active')] (dropped MOCK_BRANDS import, kept onSelect setBrandId/setBrandName + save unchanged); (2) web WebProductScreen.tsx product-modal brand dropdown selected-name lookup -> brandStore.getBrand(brandId)?.name, save brandName -> brandStore.getBrand(brandId)?.name, active-brand list -> brandStore.getBrands().filter(b=>b.status==='active'); (3) WebProductScreen MasterScreen 'ยี่ห้อ' tab rewired: removed local useState([...MOCK_BRANDS]); brands now derived from brandStore.getBrands().map(...) with live getBrandProductCount per brand; handleAddBrand/handleSaveEditBrand/handleDeleteBrand/handleToggleBrandStatus now call brandStore.addBrand/updateBrand/deleteBrand/updateBrand(toggle) + bump brandRefreshKey. MOCK_BRANDS import removed from both product screens (no other refs). Product save still works (brandId/brandName unchanged on save). VERIFY: npm run lint = 13 tsc errors (== baseline, 0 in new/edited files); npm test = 24 passed, same 3 pre-existing suites fail to load (engine/SyncService/branchPermissionStore react-native import-analysis). No new failures. NOTE: CategoryManageScreen.tsx (mobile) still uses its own local MOCK_BRANDS state — out of scope (task named only AddEditProductScreen + WebProductScreen pickers), not touched.
